messages:
Sam (DevEx): quick idea from a support spike: add a "quick-scan" line for each invocation that surfaces a one-line summary + schema status so users can scan runs faster.
Mai (UX): love that. keep it lightweight: summary + tokens + status badge. users said opening full payload is too noisy.
Ethan (Frontend): implementation note: render the summary from invocation metadata to avoid parsing big blobs. click expands to fetch full payload.
Pri (Eng-ML): backend can attach summary and small validation state at run time. ensure PII/redaction runs before returning full payload on expand.
Lina (Design): a11y nits: badge needs aria-labels like "Schema: mismatch". control must be keyboard operable and announce state changes via aria-live.
Sam (DevEx): telemetry: quickscan_shown, quickscan_expand, quickscan_apply_all. want expand latency <300ms.
Ethan (Frontend): dev plan: per-invocation toggle, 'apply to all' in toolbar later; persist pref in localStorage. estimate 2d dev + QA.
Pri (Eng-ML): also include ETag on full payload responses so client can cache heavy fetches.
Lina (Design): microcopy suggestion: badge labels: "Matches", "Partial", "Mismatch". tooltip: "Open schema editor" for mismatch.
flag-bot: feature flag created: quickscan-invokes -> staging.
Mai (UX): next steps: Ethan will open WIP PR with mocked metadata; Lina will upload final microcopy; Sam will add analytics names to the ticket.
Sam (DevEx): thanks all 44d will review PR when ready.
